mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (room_type, reference_type, reference_id, name, status) VALUES (#{roomType}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceId}, #{name}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_type, reference_type, reference_id, name, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM chat_room WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT cr.id, cr.room_type, cr.reference_type, cr.reference_id, cr.name, cr.status, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at, cr.deleted_at, crp.participant_role AS my_participant_role FROM chat_room cr INNER JOIN chat_room_participant crp ON cr.id = crp.chat_room_id WHERE crp.user_id = #{userId} AND crp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY cr.updated_at DESC

SELECT cr.id, cr.room_type, cr.reference_type, cr.reference_id, cr.name, cr.status, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at, cr.deleted_at FROM chat_room cr WHERE cr.deleted_at IS NULL AND cr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cr.room_type IN ('GROUP', 'CHANNEL') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_room_participant crp WHERE crp.chat_room_id = cr.id AND crp.user_id = #{userId} AND crp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY cr.updated_at DESC

SELECT cr.id FROM chat_room cr INNER JOIN chat_room_participant p1 ON cr.id = p1.chat_room_id AND p1.user_id = #{userId1} AND p1.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN chat_room_participant p2 ON cr.id = p2.chat_room_id AND p2.user_id = #{userId2} AND p2.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE cr.room_type = 'DIRECT' AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
